title: Generate shopping
subtitle: A shopping plan works out what your meals need, takes off the confirmed stock, rounds up to pack sizes, then writes the result to your normal shopping list — without undoing your purchases or your manual changes.
empty: No shopping plan yet. Create one from an event, from this week's meal plan or from a few recipes.

source-help.EVENT: The recipes and portions come from the menu and the guests of the event.
source-help.MEALPLAN: The recipes come from the meal planner, between these two dates included.
source-help.RECIPES: Choose recipes. The multiplier says how many times to prepare each one.

never-computed: Not sent to a shopping list yet
delete-confirm: Delete the plan "{name}"? The shopping list it created stays as it is.

form.name: Plan name
form.no-events: No event yet. Choose "Meal plan" or "Recipes", or create an event first.
form.dates-invalid: The end date is before the start date.
form.use-stock-help: Only stock marked "confirmed usable" is deducted from what you need to buy.
form.use-packaging-help: The quantity to buy is rounded up to a whole number of packs.
form.target-list-help: The list is only created or changed when you update the shopping.

detail.not-found: This shopping plan was not found.
detail.computed-note: The quantities are computed by the application from your recipes, your stock and your pack sizes. No AI takes part in this calculation.
detail.done-info: This plan is done: the meal was cooked and the stock was reduced.
detail.no-lines: This plan needs no ingredient for now.
detail.dismissed: You deleted it from the list — it will not be created again
detail.dismissed-restore: You deleted it from the list — it will be created again at the next update
detail.list-quantity: Quantity in the list after the update: {quantity}

warning.UNIT_MISMATCH: Stock held in another unit, not deducted

issue.MISSING_SERVINGS: This recipe does not state its number of servings
issue.NO_VARIANT: No compatible dish for this person

receive.help: The checked items of the shopping list go into the stock. Each item is put away only once.
receive.done: Items put into stock: {received} · Already put away: {skipped}
receive.nothing: No checked item to put away. Check your purchases in the shopping list first.

consume.confirm: The stock is reduced by what this plan needed, then the plan is closed. This cannot be undone.
consume.done: Plan closed. Foods deducted from stock: {count}
